channel.title: Unintended Consequences
channel.description: A daily narrative podcast profiling inventions, policies, and systems that were meant to help — but triggered surprising, unintended consequences. From the Cobra Effect to social media algorithms, every episode follows a single case study through good intentions, implementation, unexpected fallout, and the lessons we can learn. Produced by the Nerra Network in Vancouver. AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
channel.itunes:author: Patrick
channel.itunes:summary: Good intentions. Surprising results. Real lessons. A daily narrative podcast on case studies of well-intentioned actions that triggered surprising fallout — from the Cobra Effect to social media algorithms.
